kind: rigid weapon (AGENTS.md: rigid items are placed by anchor with integer offsets)
status: CANDIDATE 2026-11-06: tanto blade with a hemp cord and an iron ring at the far end (Kyoketsu-Shoge); used by Cord Garrote and Blade Throw, where the cord shows
construction: band: a straight band along the weapon axis from the grip point (the centre of the near fist); every pixel takes its colour from the cross-section pattern (back/spine to front/edge) of the segment it falls in, so the weapon keeps its thickness at any angle; pixels are rasterised from the authored data, never rotated or resampled from an image
paletteSource: colours already in the approved male clothing layers: #adadad armour grey (blade steel, guard, pommel), #ffffff armour/Gi white (edge), #3b2014 Gi shoe brown (hilt wrap), #a9977d Gi trouser shade (hilt diamonds), #ddcdb4 Gi trouser mid (blade collar)
units: pixels along the axis from the grip point (u, positive toward the tip) and across it (v)
outline: every coloured pixel touching empty space gets an outline pixel (#) if it is not already one
grip: one-handed off-hand dagger: the hilt is entirely inside the fist, so only the pommel nub and the guard show at the fist's two edges
note: the katana construction as a dagger: blade 6.5 px; the hilt segment is not drawn (the fist covers u -2.5 to 2.5)

trail.rule: swing smear colours, from the blade tip inward (pixels from the outer edge): colours already in the approved palette (Gi/armour white, body wrap grey, armour grey); hard alpha

chain.rule: Kyoketsu-Shoge: a hemp cord (kama handle wood ramp #9e4a31/#70241d, dark enough to read over the white Gi) leaves the tanto pommel and ends in an iron ring (#adadad); hangs in screen space like the kama chain; poses set chain.via/to/droop/noWeight
